name: Wrist Knot
description: Tie a quick knot of qi round a foe's wrist so the arm cannot swing free for a few breaths.

name: Snug Loop
description: Throw a loop of qi cord over a foe's shoulder and draw it snug to pin the arm to the body.

name: Cord Snap
description: Flick a taut cord of qi like a short whip so its tip cracks against a foe's guard.

name: Tether Sense
description: Touch a thread of qi to a held line to feel its tension and learn how hard the far end pulls.

name: Knot Net
description: Weave small knots of qi into a net before the chest to catch a thrown stone or blade.

name: Ankle Loop
description: Drop a loop of qi round a foe's ankle so the next step drags and falters.

name: Twin Cord
description: Hold two cords of qi on two limbs of one foe and keep both taut with steady breath.

name: Slip Hitch
description: Catch an incoming blow in a sliding hitch of qi that turns it harmlessly to the side.

name: Cord Lash
description: Whip a length of qi cord across a foe's forearm hard enough to numb the grip.

name: Loop Pull
description: Cast a loop over a fixed beam and haul the body across a short gap in one pull.

name: Slack Reading
description: Run a thread along a bound line to feel whether the knot at its far end has begun to slip.

name: Anchor Knot
description: Fix a knot of qi into the ground at a foe's feet and tie the stance to it.

name: Closing Noose
description: Slip a noose of qi round a foe's waist and tighten it a notch with every pull.

name: Short Leash
description: Clip a short line of qi to a foe's belt so the foe cannot stray far from the user.

name: Tied Guard
description: Knot a flat plate of qi across the forearm to hold off a cut or a blow.

name: Needle Thread
description: Stiffen a thread of qi into a needle and jab it at a foe's shoulder joint.

name: Cinch Yank
description: Yank a cord tied to a foe's arm to spoil a half-drawn strike.

name: Weight Feel
description: Weigh a tied foe's pull by the strain in the cord to judge strength and balance.

name: Thread Cast
description: Throw a weighted thread of qi that coils round the target on contact and holds the limb.

name: Holding Stitch
description: Stitch a foe's sleeve to the ground with a pin of qi so the arm stays pulled down.

name: Fine Tie
description: Tie the ends of a foe's cloak together with a hair of qi so the next stride trips.

name: Strand Guard
description: Stretch a strand of qi across a line of attack to snag and turn a thrown dart.

name: Strand Count
description: Count the threads running between two bound things to learn how many ties hold them.

name: Steady Tether
description: Hold a firm tether of qi on one foe so the foe stays within a fixed reach of the user.

name: Tether Draw
description: Draw the body along a tether fixed to a pole so the user lands beside it.

name: Strained Cord
description: Stretch a taut line round a foe's chest until the breath shortens and the strikes lose force.

name: Tether Brace
description: Anchor the user's own stance with two tethers to the floor so a shove cannot move it.

name: Lending Tether
description: Link a tether between two allies and let the stronger lend a trickle of steadiness to the weaker.

name: Tension Gauge
description: Judge from a tether's quiver how much strain an ally or a foe can still bear.

name: Clasp Grip
description: Close a clasp of qi round a foe's hand so the fingers lock open and drop their hold.

name: Quick Release
description: Cut loose a tether the instant a foe pulls and spring clear of the tug.

name: Hold Fast
description: Clasp the user's arms to the body with bands of qi to resist being pulled apart.

name: Clasp Pin
description: Pin both of a foe's sleeves together with a clasp of qi so the arms are held crossed.

name: Binding Palm
description: Slap a palm charged with binding qi onto a foe's chest to cramp their breath.

name: Open Hand
description: Loosen an ally's clenched fists and stiff joints with a stroke so qi flows freely again.

name: Latch Sense
description: Feel with a fingertip whether a lock or latch has been set with qi.

name: Snap Release
description: Unclasp every tie at once and let the freed cords whip back against the foe.

name: Lasting Bond
description: Bind two allies' breathing into one slow rhythm so each steadies the other through a hard effort.

name: Fast Bond
description: Fix a foe's wrist to the user's own with a bond of qi so neither can pull away.

name: Bond Shield
description: Draw an ally into the user's bond so a single guard of qi covers both.

name: Binding Pulse
description: Send a short pulse down a bond so the foe at the end of it staggers.

name: Bond Reading
description: Read the strength and age of a bond between two beings by touching its line.

name: Loose Hold
description: Slide out of a grapple by slackening a bond of qi at the exact moment of the foe's pull.

name: Binder's Stance
description: Stand square with ropes of qi tied from hips to ground so the user cannot be tipped over.

name: First Binding
description: Close a plain binding of qi round a foe's arms against the sides.

name: Hobble Knot
description: Tie both of a foe's knees with a short knot so the gait shortens to a shuffle.

name: Cord Draw
description: Draw a bound foe slowly toward the user by shortening the cord a hand's breadth at a time.

name: Fray Test
description: Test a binding with a flick to learn which strand is weakest.

name: Spare Cord
description: Hand an ally a ready coil of qi cord that the ally can use as a first binding.

name: Whip Loop
description: Swing a looped cord in a flat arc that snaps across a foe's thighs.
